headline: AlphaGenome 2 reports higher cell-type-specific variant recall in genomic benchmarks
summary: Google DeepMind announced AlphaGenome 2, a genomic sequence model that conditions predictions on a target tissue, cell type or cell state. In the linked manuscript, the authors report that on the TenK10K single-cell eQTL causality task it reached 30% recall at 90% precision, compared with 16% for AlphaGenome 1 fine-tuned on single-cell data; reported overall AUPRC was 0.76 versus 0.72 for that baseline and 0.69 for Scooby. The authors also report higher recall for cell-type eQTL sign prediction. These are first-party computational results on existing datasets, not an independent reproduction or new wet-lab validation. The API is offered for non-commercial research; model source code and weights are planned for final publication. The authors state that the system is not validated for clinical or diagnostic use.
